title: On the Books
description: Date-range filters need a precise, documented boundary — otherwise "this month's report" and "last month's report" either double-count or drop a shipment that lands exactly on the line. Prove which side of the `to` boundary is included.
successCondition: Book a shipment and note its createdAt. GET /api/reporting/summary with to set to exactly that createdAt does NOT include it (totalShipments excludes it), but the same query with to set to one millisecond later DOES include it — proving `to` is exclusive, not inclusive.
hints: The created shipment's createdAt comes back in the booking response — use it directly rather than estimating current time.
The exact inclusive/exclusive convention is documented in docs/api/reporting.md — don't assume, verify.
